original_method: OS temporary project with inherited ACL; Path.glob/rglob could omit inaccessible child directories
observed: Host could read its original fixture files but Get-ChildItem and icacls on sandbox-created .elenchus returned Access denied. Parent ACL showed CodexSandboxUsers Modify plus SYSTEM, Administrators and OWNER RIGHTS; no explicit host-user ACE.
inference: A sandbox-created child may have a different owner; OWNER RIGHTS does not provide the original host identity read access. The unreadable child's ACL was not observed directly.

interpretation: An empty artifact map from the original collector is not evidence of no writes. Artifact completeness and automatic stop detection are unobserved for these unreadable directories. Visible replies and already published events remain usable.
